flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8765/ then You are a blind user who navigates with the keyboard only (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, arrow keys). The mouse does not work and the screen is black.
Select seat 14C and book it.
Verify the page says "Booked 14C".

wait: Waiting after verifying keyboard accessibility

summary:
The seat is shown as something that can be selected, but it cannot receive keyboard focus. As a result, pressing keyboard keys does not select it or enable booking.
Make each selectable seat a native button or otherwise keyboard-focusable control, and support Enter and Space to select it. Verify that Tab can reach 14C and that booking then displays “Booked 14C”.
evidence: objective_contradiction: Seat 14C is a non-focusable DIV (tabIndex -1), so keyboard-only navigation cannot select it.
one_liner: Seat 14C cannot be chosen by a keyboard-only user, so the booking cannot be completed.
